about.title: Head Wrestling Coach
about.bio: From youth development through high school varsity competition, I build wrestlers who are technically sound, physically conditioned, and mentally resilient. My coaching focuses on the fundamental positions and movements that create winners — not just athletes who look good in practice.

hero.headline: Shoot. Control. Win.
hero.subline: Private wrestling coaching — takedowns, defensive positioning, and conditioning for athletes who want to compete at the highest level.

services.title: Takedowns & Defensive Stance

services.title: Mat Control & Positioning

services.title: Conditioning & Weight Management
services.description: Wrestling-specific conditioning protocols and responsible weight management guidance for competitive athletes.

faq.question: What age groups do you train?
faq.answer: I work with wrestlers from youth (6+) through high school level. Sessions are appropriate to age and current skill level.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Sessions take place at local wrestling facilities with proper matting. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How long are sessions?
faq.answer: Sessions run 60–75 minutes. Live drilling rounds are kept appropriate to conditioning level.

faq.question: What should my wrestler bring?
faq.answer: Singlet or athletic shorts and rash guard, wrestling shoes if available, and water. Headgear is optional.

faq.question: Do you offer group sessions?
faq.answer: Yes — small group sessions (2–4 wrestlers at similar skill levels) are available. Great for live drilling scenarios.
